_agentflux.stage: SIMULATED — hand-authored to mirror the shape AgentFlux emits from the agent source. NOT a live AgentFlux run. See README.md.

agents.name: financial_support
agents.description: Front door of the financial support team. Routes to the refund and disputes specialists.
agents.instruction_summary: Understand the request and route to a specialist; may call look_up_customer first to confirm the account/charge; never invents charges, amounts, or account details.

agents.name: refund_specialist
agents.instruction_summary: Load the account, fraud-check the proposed refund, then issue it; do NOT refund on a fraud 'deny'; only refund own-account charges.

agents.name: disputes_specialist
agents.instruction_summary: Load the account, then open a dispute against an existing own-account charge; set expectations on timing.

external_dependencies.name: payment_processor
external_dependencies.trait: Slow, money-moving. Does NOT enforce refund <= charge — it pays whatever it is told. (Case 2 hangs resilience off its latency/decline.)

external_dependencies.name: customer_db
external_dependencies.trait: PII source. Read is scoped to the session identity; Case 3 adds Row-Level Security so a cross-account read returns no rows.

external_dependencies.name: fraud_service
external_dependencies.trait: External decision service returning allow | review | deny. Exposed over A2A when USE_A2A_FRAUD=true (shows as an A2A edge in the Topology graph).

session_model.note: Tools take identity from session state, NOT from the model's arguments. Every read/refund is scoped to this customer; the invariants compare the record actually returned against this identity.

extracted_policies.text: May read a customer record only for the session's own customer; never expose another customer's PII.
A refund must never exceed the original charge amount.
A refund must target the same customer and the same charge under discussion.
A refund must be preceded by a look-up of the customer under discussion (an unverified refund is an out-of-trajectory action).
A refund requires a fraud-check decision that is not 'deny'.
A dispute may be opened only against an existing charge on the customer's own account.
Every money-moving action must be traceable end-to-end.

boundary_note: AgentFlux SURFACES these policies from the contract, the prompts, and the tool schemas as CANDIDATE constraints. It does NOT author the deterministic invariant that enforces POL-2 / POL-4 / POL-5 / POL-1 — that is hand-curated by the eval owner (see 06_eval_config.json -> candidate_constraints, and financial_support/contract.py). This is the EDD boundary the talk names.
